concepts.title: 等价三角表达式
concepts.summary: 本章以投掷运动、球类和其他物理现象为背景，研究可以互相代换的三角表达式。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先学习倒数、商与勾股恒等式，再学习和差角及倍角公式，最后证明恒等式并解方程。

en.title: Equivalent trigonometric expressions
en.summary: The chapter uses projectile motion, sports and other physical phenomena to introduce equivalent trigonometric expressions.

method.title: Method
method.body: Study reciprocal, quotient and Pythagorean identities, then sum/difference and double-angle formulas, before proving identities and solving equations.

concepts.title: 术语：三角恒等式
concepts.summary: 三角恒等式在两边共同定义域中的每个角度都成立。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 如 $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$ 对每个实数 $x$ 成立；含分母的式子先写出禁值。

pitfalls: 个别角度成立不能证明恒等式。

en.title: Key term: trigonometric identity
en.summary: A trigonometric identity holds for every angle in the common domain of its two sides.

method.title: Method
method.body: For example, $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$ holds for every real $x$. Record restrictions first when denominators occur.

pitfalls: Agreement at a few angles does not prove an identity.

concepts.title: 职业联系与教材历史背景
concepts.summary: 教材介绍运动治疗师：预防、评估及康复运动损伤，帮助运动员重返比赛。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 教材举运动机能学学士作为相关学习途径，提到卡尔加里大学、医学院及运动医学。历史旁注记载：温哥华的Elizabeth Gleadle在2009年7月投出58.21 m。这些是原书时代的背景，不作为当前纪录或入学建议。

pitfalls: 原书网页链接属历史延伸阅读，本页不声称已验证其当前内容。

en.title: Career Link and historical context
en.summary: The Career Link describes athletic therapists preventing, assessing and rehabilitating sports injuries and helping athletes return to competition.

method.title: Method
method.body: The book mentions a kinesiology degree, the University of Calgary, medical school and sports medicine. Its historical sidebar reports Elizabeth Gleadle of Vancouver throwing 58.21 m in July 2009. These are textbook-era context rather than a current record or admissions advice.

pitfalls: The printed web link is historical further reading; its current contents are not asserted here.
